summary: Plan APPENDED to the 07-20 baseline. Four ordered changes (D1-D4) for the operator-directed swap to embedded SurrealDB on mobile AND desktop, replacing InMemoryProvider at uar.rs:880. BLOCKER found while planning: providers::surreal is behind the surreal-backend feature gate, and gen_ui_agent depends on UAR with only [embedded-mobile, in-memory-backend] — so SurrealDbProvider does not exist in this build and a constructor swap would not compile. Enabling the feature (D1) must come first. Fortunate: SurrealDbProvider normalizes rocksdb:// to surrealkv://, the exact scheme KnowMe already uses at gen_ui_host:264.
next: Apply D1: enable surreal-backend and verify it cross-compiles for host, aarch64-linux-android and aarch64-apple-ios.
warnings: Cross-compilation is the live risk — SurrealKV for two mobile triples is unproven here; D1 exists to find out before any call-site edit.

TWO boot paths must be threaded: mobile uses gen_ui_ffi::api::boot and never touches gen_ui_host. Wiring only the host leaves Android and iOS broken while desktop looks fixed — the media work hit this exact trap.
A failed SurrealDB connection must surface as a visible boot failure, never a silent fallback to memory; a fallback would recreate the defect while appearing to work.
The other 13 tasks in tasks.md are NOT planned here and are untrustworthy as written — re-verify each against code first.
